1	# US-China Trade War: Tariffs, Trade Volumes, and Supply Chain Shifts (2016–2024)
2	
3	## Overview
4	This collection of datasets tracks the evolution of the US-China trade war from 2016 to 2024, covering tariff rate changes, bilateral trade volumes, supply chain diversification patterns, and key policy milestones.
5	
6	## Data Source
7	
8	### tariff_rates
9	Average effective tariff rates by half-year period (2017-H1 to 2024-H1). Fields: `period` (string, format YYYY-HX), `us_tariff_on_china` (percent, range 3.1–25.4), `china_tariff_on_us` (percent, range 8.0–23.1). Rates represent trade-weighted averages across all tariff lines.
10	
11	### bilateral_trade
12	Annual US-China bilateral trade from 2016 to 2024. Fields: `year` (integer), `us_exports_to_china` (billion USD), `us_imports_from_china` (billion USD), `total_bilateral` (billion USD, sum of exports and imports).
13	
14	### supply_chain_share
15	Annual share of total US goods imports by source. Fields: `year` (integer), `china` (percent), `vietnam` (percent), `india` (percent), `rest_of_world` (percent). Values for each year sum to approximately 100%.
16	
17	### policy_events
18	Key policy milestones. Fields: `date` (ISO date string), `period_approx` (corresponding half-year period), `event` (short description), `category` (one of: investigation, tariff, deal, review). Contains 12 events spanning August 2017 to May 2024.
19	
20	## Data Notes
21	- Tariff rates are approximate trade-weighted averages and may differ from statutory rates on specific product categories
22	- 2024 data is partial (H1 only for tariffs; full-year trade figures are estimates)
23	- Supply chain shares are rounded and may not sum to exactly 100%
24	- Rest-of-world is a residual category capturing all non-China, non-Vietnam, non-India imports

## Overview

This skill enables extraction of Mermaid diagrams from markdown files and generation of high-quality PNG images. The skill bundles all necessary scripts (`extract-and-generate.sh`, `extract_diagrams.py`, and `puppeteer-config.json`) in the `scripts/` directory for portability and reliability.


```bash
cd ~/.claude/skills/mermaid-tools/scripts
./extract-and-generate.sh "/path/to/document.md" "/path/to/output"
```

C_CHINA       = '#C0392B'   # red-brown
C_VIETNAM     = '#27AE60'   # green
C_INDIA       = '#F39C12'   # amber
C_REST        = '#BDC3C7'   # grey
C_GRID        = '#E8E8E8'
C_TEXT        = '#2C2C2C'
C_ANNOT       = '#555555'
BG_PANEL      = '#FAFAFA'

# ── Parse half-year periods to numeric x ───────────────────────────────
def period_to_x(period):
    year, half = period.split('-H')
    return int(year) + (0.0 if half == '1' else 0.5)

tariff_x = [period_to_x(d['period']) for d in tariff]
us_tar   = [d['us_tariff_on_china'] for d in tariff]
cn_tar   = [d['china_tariff_on_us'] for d in tariff]

trade_yr = [d['year'] for d in trade]
us_exp   = [d['us_exports_to_china'] for d in trade]
us_imp   = [d['us_imports_from_china'] for d in trade]
tot_trd  = [d['total_bilateral'] for d in trade]

sup_yr   = [d['year'] for d in supply]
china_sh = [d['china'] for d in supply]
vn_sh    = [d['vietnam'] for d in supply]
in_sh    = [d['india'] for d in supply]
row_sh   = [d['rest_of_world'] for d in supply]

# ── Event annotations (select key ones to avoid clutter) ───────────────
key_events = [
    ('2018-H1', 'Section 301\nMemo signed', 'tariff'),
    ('2018-H2', 'Lists 1-3\ntariffs imposed', 'tariff'),
    ('2019-H1', 'List 3 → 25%\non $200B', 'tariff'),
    ('2019-H2', 'List 4A: 15%\non $112B', 'tariff'),
    ('2020-H1', 'Phase One\nDeal signed', 'deal'),
    ('2024-H1', 'Biden raises\ntariffs (EVs, etc.)', 'tariff'),
]

def event_x(period):
    return period_to_x(period)

# ── Create figure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 22), facecolor='white')

# Three stacked panels with shared x-range
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 1, height_ratios=[1.1, 0.9, 1.0],
                      hspace=0.18, left=0.08, right=0.92, top=0.93, bottom=0.04)

ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0])  # Tariffs + events
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1])  # Bilateral trade volume
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2])  # Supply chain share

x_min, x_max = 2016.5, 2024.8

for ax in [ax1, ax2, ax3]:
    ax.set_facecolor(BG_PANEL)
    ax.set_xlim(x_min, x_max)
    ax.tick_params(colors=C_TEXT, labelsize=10)
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['left'].set_color('#CCCCCC')
    ax.spines['bottom'].set_color('#CCCCCC')
    ax.grid(axis='y', color=C_GRID, linewidth=0.6, zorder=0)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 1 — Tariff Escalation Timeline
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax1.fill_between(tariff_x, us_tar, alpha=0.12, color=C_US_TARIFF, zorder=1)
ax1.fill_between(tariff_x, cn_tar, alpha=0.10, color=C_CN_TARIFF, zorder=1)

ax1.plot(tariff_x, us_tar, color=C_US_TARIFF, linewidth=2.5, marker='o',
         markersize=5, label='US tariff on Chinese imports', zorder=3)
ax1.plot(tariff_x, cn_tar, color=C_CN_TARIFF, linewidth=2.5, marker='s',
         markersize=5, label='China tariff on US imports', zorder=3)

# Step-shading to show escalation phases
ax1.axvspan(2018.0, 2019.5, alpha=0.06, color='#FF0000', zorder=0)
ax1.axvspan(2024.0, 2024.8, alpha=0.06, color='#FF0000', zorder=0)

# Event annotations
for period, label, cat in key_events:
    ex = event_x(period)
    color = '#1A5276' if cat == 'deal' else C_ANNOT
    ax1.axvline(ex, color=color, linewidth=0.7, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, zorder=1)
    ax1.annotate(label, xy=(ex, ax1.get_ylim()[1]),
                 xytext=(0, 8), textcoords='offset points',
                 fontsize=7.5, color=color, ha='center', va='bottom',
                 fontweight='bold',
                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='white',
                           edgecolor=color, alpha=0.85, linewidth=0.5))

ax1.set_ylabel('Average Effective Tariff Rate (%)', fontsize=11, color=C_TEXT, fontweight='medium')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 30)
ax1.set_xticks([])
ax1.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#CCCCCC')

# Escalation label
ax1.annotate('Escalation\nphase', xy=(2018.7, 27), fontsize=8, color='#922B21',
             ha='center', fontstyle='italic', alpha=0.7)

ax1.set_title('US–China Tariff Escalation & Key Policy Events',
              fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=C_TEXT, pad=10, loc='left')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 2 — Bilateral Trade Volume
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax2.fill_between(trade_yr, us_exp, alpha=0.25, color=C_US_EXPORTS, zorder=1)
ax2.fill_between(trade_yr, us_imp, alpha=0.15, color=C_US_IMPORTS, zorder=1)

ax2.plot(trade_yr, tot_trd, color=C_TOTAL_TRADE, linewidth=2.8, marker='D',
         markersize=5, label='Total bilateral trade', zorder=3)
ax2.plot(trade_yr, us_exp, color=C_US_EXPORTS, linewidth=1.8, marker='o',
         markersize=4, label='US exports to China', zorder=2)
ax2.plot(trade_yr, us_imp, color=C_US_IMPORTS, linewidth=1.8, marker='s',
         markersize=4, label='US imports from China', zorder=2)

# Highlight the dip
dip_yr, dip_val = 2019, 558.6
peak_yr, peak_val = 2022, 690.6
ax2.annotate(f'Peak tariff dip\n${dip_val:.0f}B',
             xy=(dip_yr, dip_val), xytext=(dip_yr + 1.2, dip_val - 60),
             fontsize=8.5, color=C_TOTAL_TRADE, fontweight='bold',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_TOTAL_TRADE, lw=1.2),
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.25', facecolor='white',
                       edgecolor=C_TOTAL_TRADE, alpha=0.9))

# Mark Phase One recovery
ax2.annotate('Phase One\nrecovery', xy=(2021, 657.5), xytext=(2020.3, 700),
             fontsize=8, color='#1A5276', fontstyle='italic',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#1A5276', lw=1))

# Mark 2022 peak
ax2.annotate(f'2022 peak\n${peak_val:.0f}B',
             xy=(peak_yr, peak_val), xytext=(peak_yr + 0.5, peak_val + 15),
             fontsize=8, color=C_TOTAL_TRADE, fontweight='bold',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_TOTAL_TRADE, lw=1))

ax2.set_ylabel('Trade Volume (Billion USD)', fontsize=11, color=C_TEXT, fontweight='medium')
ax2.set_ylim(0, 780)
ax2.set_xticks([])
ax2.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#CCCCCC')
ax2.set_title('US–China Bilateral Trade Volume',
              fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=C_TEXT, pad=10, loc='left')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL 3 — Supply Chain Diversification
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Stacked area chart
ax3.fill_between(sup_yr, 0, china_sh, color=C_CHINA, alpha=0.70, label='China')
ax3.fill_between(sup_yr, china_sh, [c+v for c,v in zip(china_sh, vn_sh)],
                 color=C_VIETNAM, alpha=0.75, label='Vietnam')
ax3.fill_between(sup_yr, [c+v for c,v in zip(china_sh, vn_sh)],
                 [c+v+i for c,v,i in zip(china_sh, vn_sh, in_sh)],
                 color=C_INDIA, alpha=0.75, label='India')
ax3.fill_between(sup_yr, [c+v+i for c,v,i in zip(china_sh, vn_sh, in_sh)], 100,
                 color=C_REST, alpha=0.30, label='Rest of World')

# Outline lines for clarity
ax3.plot(sup_yr, china_sh, color=C_CHINA, linewidth=1.5, zorder=3)
ax3.plot(sup_yr, [c+v for c,v in zip(china_sh, vn_sh)],
         color=C_VIETNAM, linewidth=0.8, zorder=3)
ax3.plot(sup_yr, [c+v+i for c,v,i in zip(china_sh, vn_sh, in_sh)],
         color=C_INDIA, linewidth=0.8, zorder=3)

# Annotate China share
ax3.annotate(f'{china_sh[0]:.1f}%', xy=(2016, china_sh[0]/2), fontsize=9,
             color='white', fontweight='bold', ha='center', va='center')
ax3.annotate(f'{china_sh[-1]:.1f}%', xy=(2024, china_sh[-1]/2), fontsize=9,
             color='white', fontweight='bold', ha='center', va='center')

# Annotate Vietnam rise
vn_start, vn_end = vn_sh[0], vn_sh[-1]
ax3.annotate(f'Vietnam\n{vn_start:.1f}%→{vn_end:.1f}%',
             xy=(2024, china_sh[-1] + vn_sh[-1]/2), fontsize=8,
             color='white', fontweight='bold', ha='center', va='center')

# Annotate India rise
ax3.annotate(f'India\n{in_sh[0]:.1f}%→{in_sh[-1]:.1f}%',
             xy=(2024, china_sh[-1] + vn_sh[-1] + in_sh[-1]/2), fontsize=7.5,
             color=C_TEXT, fontweight='bold', ha='center', va='center')

# Divergence arrow after 2018
ax3.annotate('', xy=(2024, china_sh[-1]), xytext=(2018, china_sh[2]),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_CHINA, lw=1.5, ls='--'))

ax3.set_ylabel('Share of US Goods Imports (%)', fontsize=11, color=C_TEXT, fontweight='medium')
ax3.set_ylim(0, 100)
ax3.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=11, color=C_TEXT, fontweight='medium')
ax3.set_xticks(range(2017, 2025))
ax3.set_xticklabels([str(y) for y in range(2017, 2025)])
ax3.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=9, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#CCCCCC')
ax3.set_title('Supply Chain Diversification: Share of US Goods Imports',
              fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=C_TEXT, pad=10, loc='left')

# Mark acceleration zone
ax3.axvline(2018.0, color=C_ANNOT, linewidth=1, linestyle=':', alpha=0.6)
ax3.annotate('Tariff escalation\nbegins', xy=(2018.0, 95), fontsize=7.5,
             color=C_ANNOT, ha='center', fontstyle='italic')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Super-title and footer
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
fig.suptitle('US–China Trade War Dynamics (2017–2024)',
             fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', color=C_TEXT, y=0.97)
fig.text(0.5, 0.005,
         'Source: Trade-weighted average effective tariff rates, US Census Bureau trade data, and UN Comtrade supply chain shares  |  Tariff rates by half-year; trade & supply chain data annual',
         ha='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#888888', fontstyle='italic')

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=200, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
print('Chart saved to /app/output/result.png')
